title: CIA sent a 'Psychic' to Mars 1 million years into past: Here's what he saw

content:
A declassified US intelligence document has resurfaced online revealing an experiment in which a supposed psychic was asked to explore Mars roughly one million years in the past.

The experiment took place on May 22, 1984, as part of the US government's research into “remote viewing,” the alleged ability to perceive distant places using the mind.

According to the document, the subject was given a sealed envelope containing the target: Mars, approximately one million years BC.

Coordinates were then read to him one by one. At the first location, the viewer described what looked like a huge pyramid sitting inside a depressed area.

As the session continued, he reported seeing enormous structures, channels and what appeared to be shelters built to survive violent storms.

Then came the people.

The viewer described extremely tall and thin figures wearing unusual fitted clothing. He believed they were members of an ancient population struggling to survive as their environment collapsed.

Some, he claimed, had left in search of somewhere else to live.

The nine-page transcript is authentic and was eventually released as part of the US government's Stargate files.

But there is a major difference between an authentic document and an authentic discovery.

There is no scientific evidence confirming that the buildings or beings described during the session ever existed on Mars.

The document proves that US intelligence experimented with remote viewing.

It doesn't prove the psychic actually saw ancient Mars.
